solves.reasoning: Awards are positive → strengthen. praised hence → reinforced. employees ignore non-criteria → disregard.
motivation is praised (positive). unintentionally (side effect). exploit (negative gaming context).
contrast to reinforced → crowded out. criteria forced externally → imposed. biased in favour of (collocation).
trivial contradicts 'the ultimate goal' context. Should be ultimate, not trivial.
conceal(숨기다) is wrong. Should be reflect(반영하다). The value doesn't accurately represent the state.
removed is wrong. Criteria are imposed(부과된) not removed(제거된).
strengthen people's commitment — natural collocation for awards.
a strong incentive to exploit — employees motivated to game the system.
the major criterion for CEOs — standard for evaluation.
strengthen = reinforce, both mean 강화하다.
endeavours = efforts, both mean 노력.
disregard = ignore, both mean 무시하다.
reinforced ↔ weakened, exact antonyms on strength axis.
underlying ↔ superficial, deep/surface antonyms.
passage: interest = 이익. (A) financial interest = 이익 ✓. (B) showed interest = 흥미 ✗.
criterion = standard for judging/deciding.
is praised and hence ___ → passive parallel, past participle reinforced.
by short-term ___ → preposition + adjective needs noun form.
In contrast to reinforced → motivation crowded out by pay.
biased in favour of = ~에 유리하게 편향된, natural collocation.
